segments.name: Ranor
segments.description: Manufactures precision welded and machined metal components, mainly for U.S. defense customers, to customer drawings and specifications.
segments.evidence: Ranor provides a full range of custom solutions to transform material into precision finished welded components and precision finished machined components up to 100 tons

segments.name: Stadco
products: tooling, molds, fixtures, jigs and dies
segments.description: Manufactures large mission-critical metal components and tooling, mainly for defense aircraft, helicopter and space programs.
segments.evidence: Stadco manufactures large mission-critical components on several high-profile military aircraft, military helicopter, and military space programs.

revenueModel.text: Defense, aerospace and precision industrial customers pay for custom fabricated and machined metal components built to their drawings and specifications.
revenueModel.evidence: We work with our customers to manufacture products in accordance with the customers' drawings and specifications.
